Mission Local reported that Alemany Farm, San Francisco’s largest urban farm, faced a $100,000–$150,000 budget gap after one-time city funding ran out. It had paused paid apprenticeship programs, reduced staff hours and launched a $200,000 fundraising campaign. The story noted that the farm provides free produce to residents and helps feed 700 families a week.
